NOTE
**Still not ready — test fixes pushed, but the PR description still shows incomplete testing**

New: The author pushed two updates (+3 lines) and says the failing tests are fixed, though CI status isn't visible here. Missing: the self-review checklist still has end-to-end functionality, corner cases, and strings unchecked, and the author hasn't confirmed CI is now green.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave it with laurynmm, who added the label, until the checklist is completed.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Please finish the testing items in the self-review checklist (buttons end-to-end, corner cases) and confirm CI is passing, per the [reviewable PRs guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html), then ask for another look.
```
